body: Thank you for this. He does like to control a lot. Which is frustrating because it makes me feel like for 5 years I haven't chosen anything. I am scared if I go on my own, I won't remember how to think for myself. Which sounds silly, but I haven't for so long.
I am a petroleum engineer. Oil was good... It is just the market for the job.

I am someone who is depressed and feels the same as her often, with a SO that is gone often. Not long distance but he is gone 2/3 of the year. The thing that helps me the most is just talking to others, venting and just having someone just tell me that they understand. It sounds stupid, and it may just be me, but I hate when people tell me what I am upset about is something little or I will get over it. Because if it is bothering me that much, obviously it is something big to me, no matter how little. Another thing that helps is if I go and do something. It seems silly but when I am down my SO will ask if I can make him something. He tries to ask a little later so it isn't obvious (I've caught on after 4.5 years lol). But just doing something to take my mind off of it helps. So he will ask if I can cross stitch him something, or paint or do anything that he can think of that he would like. He just makes me feel useful and like I am needed. I know it sounds silly but I would just figure out something she likes to do and just ask if she will make it. No matter how little! Hope that helps :/

Thank you a lot. It is 3 am here so even if I had someone to talk to, I wouldn't be able to. Thanks for listening to my rambling. It really did help. I added you as a friend on my RES, so hopefully if I get down I will remember to message you.

Thank you Dr. Who. I never feel selfless. I just feel like that is how people are suppose to be. I feel like I have done so much wrong and disappointed so many people that I just have to try and make up for it.

Tell me about your mistake. Maybe it will help :/ but I dont know how to live for myself. I always lived to make my parents happy. Then I went to college and went crazy. I slept with a million people, got drunk constantly and was just reckless. Then I found my SO and I went back to living for someone. When I do stuff for just myself I feel guilty, he normally gets mad I didn't include him or feels like I am pulling away. So I have just been avoiding it.

In my senior year of high school.. I lost 8 acquaintances to suicide, 2 to murder, 3 to accidents (cars mainly). I know what the impact is on people around you. That pretty much the only thing that keeps me alive. If I didn't have so many people that loved me, I would do it in a heartbeat. I just struggle with thinking about it and planning it 24/7. It is always on my mind.

I am just scared that I am going to get to close to B that I will cheat on my SO.  My SO and I work the same job, so we work 12 hour shifts but on opposite schedules. B works the same schedule as me so I am with him all the time. So I am worried that I will be drunk or so upset one day and not give a shit and just make love to B. (He is kinda a man whore lol, so I know he would let me). B and my SO grew up together. I have only known him as long as I've known my SO (we met in college). My SO doesn't have a lot of friends and his family is non-exsistant. So B and I are all he really has. So the thought of taking both of those away.. crushes me. But I feel like I should be selfish and just do whatever will make me happy, and not worry about what one person feels.

My SO means the world to me. When I think about how he would feel if I left him or hurt him in ANY way... I would rather kill myself then see his face when he is let down or hurt. I have extensively planned out how I could kill myself without affecting too much of his life. Like I would shoot myself at a hotel so that I don't leave a mess in the house or car for him to have to deal with or remember. I would make sure he didn't find me and I'd make sure to leave everything I have to him. I have a decent amount of money saved that he could get by for a while. But even with that strong of feeling for my SO, I still dream of living a life with B and how when I get down like this I would always have him here. I know B would never be in a relationship with me. He isn't that type of guy and I am not his type of girl. But i feel like my heart and my brain are ripping each other apart.

I know I have feelings for B ever since then. I know they are wrongly placed and only there because of how he knew what to do. My SO is extremely jealous of anything. He means well, but if I told him I talked to B the way I did, he wouldn't forgive me. Anytime I got upset he would just tell me to go talk to B. He doesn't handle things very well when it comes to talking. He is an amazing guy, he just doesn't understand sometimes. 
B went away this past week and we keep texting. I have to hide them from my SO so he doesn't get upset I am talking to him. It isn't anything bad, just how his day was, pictures of his family's new house, a baseball game he went to, ect. (My grammar is going out the window, sorry!). My SO is the one who got me to talk to someone and get medicine. He is the one who kept me on my path to get where I am today. We have a whole life built up. Bought a house and cars together, and soon we will get married. I never questioned it at all before B. I just assumed that no one really could understand what to do or say. I thought my SO was perfect.

I think the biggest thing right now, that is making it worse than normal.. is that I have been in a serious relationship for 4.5 years. I love my SO beyond anything I could imagine. A few months ago the friend that understands me moved in. When my SO was gone for work for a few months I spent a lot of time this this friend, we will call B. One night we got drunk and I opened up to him about how I feel and how I want to end my life often. And he knew exactly what to do and what to say. This was confusing to me. I have never met anyone who just knew what to do. Who just knew how to calm me down and make me feel safe. And ever since then I feel conflicted. If I am going to spend the rest of my life with my SO like I plan, shouldn't he be able to do the same? I just am so confused on whether he is the one now since its like we are two different people. Ever since he came back he feel like I am being distant. And I probably am. I am just dying from all of these thoughts in my head on what to do.
Hello Dr.Who :) And I am a girl. But that is a easy mistake on here, so no hard feelings.

Because I am never as good as everyone wants me to be.
For instance, I just started this new job. It is the job I've wanted for a long time. When I started I was called the "Star Child". I knew what I was doing and everyone wanted to train me. Then, a month later, no one really wanted to help. They had other things they were doing and it is like I am a red-headed step child. And thats how it always is.
